correctness.rationale: For exactly three neutral Kingman lineages, with pair hazard h(t), P(K_t=3)=exp(-3H) and P(K_t=2)=3/2[exp(-H)-exp(-3H)], giving singleton and doubleton active branch counts (3/2)(exp(-H)+/- exp(-3H)). Swapping whole adjacent hazard blocks u<v, lengths Lu,Lv, preserves final cumulative hazard, so prefix and post-block tail integrals cancel. Direct integration produces J_alpha(uv)-J_alpha(vu)=exp(-alpha*x)(v-u)(1-exp(-alpha*u*Lu))(1-exp(-alpha*v*Lv))/(alpha*u*v). Set X=exp(-uLu), Y=exp(-vLv), D=(v-u)(1-X)(1-Y)/(uv)>0, R=(1+X+X^2)(1+Y+Y^2)/3. Hence Delta_1=(3muD/2)exp(-3x)(exp(2x)+R)>0 and Delta_2 same with minus R; total positive. Along positive common duration scale R(s) strictly decreases 3->1/3, proving unique doubleton sign switch exactly when x<ln(3)/2; equality case correctly has no finite switch. Exact independent two-block algebra and rational witness X=3/4,Y=1/2,R=259/192 checked. Finite quadrature is not proof of the universal expression.
